applicability.basis: Frozen calibrated implementation and official attack_model.py llm_eval use one tokenized sequence for suspect and Llama reference. Qwen IDs have different meaning. No native separate-tokenizer calibrated implementation established in pinned code/README. Replacing the token unit or reference/calibration has unproven equivalence and is not approved. This is a limitation of the frozen protocol, not a claim all possible EverTracer variants cannot cross architectures.
